options.description: A newline-separated list of NuGet package files (.nupkg) to push to the NuGet feed. Wildcards are supported.
Specify the API key to access a NuGet packages feed. For built-in TeamCity NuGet server, specify %teamcity.nuget.feed.api.key%

Specify the NuGet packages feed URL to push packages to. Leave blank to let NuGet decide what package repository to use. To use a [TeamCity NuGet feed](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/using-teamcity-as-nuget-feed.html), specify the URL from the NuGet feed project settings page.
Enter additional parameters to use when calling [nuget push](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/nuget/tools/cli-ref-push) command
